what: Look decisions LOOK-B1 and LOOK-B2 (co-design.json, look_decisions_for_user): the demo look checked against c94e849, and the family film count measured on the current tree. WebGL2 preview of the delivered GLSL, not TouchDesigner.

reproduced_from_files.how: Each capture as committed at c94e849 (git show) against the current file: max per-channel difference /255 and pixels over 8/255 (checks: scratch reproduce.py of the look-acceptance round). WebGL2 previews (Chromium SwiftShader), not TouchDesigner.
reproduced_from_files.reading: The family close did not change the demo look (0 to 1/255). The decisions are about two member-specific rules.

option_family_film_count.how: Current tree, checks/preview harness, 800 x 450, time 3, each preset at its defaults; the family count drawn with a test patch that multiplies the film lookup by 1.45 ('pObj * (uFilm.w * 1.45) * worldScale()'). Images: captures/review-look-decisions.png.

ripple_units.how: Code read: blobs.frag ripple(p) uses uMotion.y (height) and uMotion.z (scale) with p in box units; study.json uMotion.z = u(Ripplescale), with no Object size; the core divides Wobble scale by Object size and multiplies its lookup by worldScale().
ripple_units.reading: No visible difference on the demo or after Fit; the two rules differ only when Object size does not match the box.
